text.en: Ministry of Education Singapore, Curriculum Planning and Development Division. Mathematics Syllabus Primary One to Six (implementation starting with the 2021 Primary One cohort; updated October 2025). Line Symmetry: p. 39; 2D Shapes: pp. 32 and 34.
text.zh: 新加坡教育部课程规划与发展司：《小学一至六年级数学课程纲要》（2021 年版，2025 年 10 月更新）。线对称：第 39 页；平面图形：第 32、34 页。

note.en: The only source for what each step covers; the syllabus lines in the lesson are quoted from it (P4 Geometry 3.1–3.3 and 2.1, P1 Geometry 1.4). Pages as printed on the PDF.
note.zh: 每一步学什么，只以这份课纲为准；课里的课纲条目照原文引用（P4 几何 3.1–3.3 和 2.1，P1 几何 1.4）。页码是 PDF 上印的页码。

text.en: Ministry of Education Singapore: primary syllabuses page.
text.zh: 新加坡教育部：小学课程纲要页面。

note.zh: 用于核对 S1 的版本。

text.en: Hart, K. M. et al. (1980). Secondary School Children's Understanding of Mathematics: A report of the mathematics component of the Concepts in Secondary Mathematics and Science Programme. London: Chelsea College (ERIC ED237363), p. 111, Table 6.11.
text.zh: Hart, K. M. 等（1980）：《中学生对数学的理解：中学数学与科学概念项目数学部分报告》。伦敦：Chelsea College（ERIC ED237363），第 111 页，表 6.11。

note.en: In the reflection items, the hardest level was reflecting flags and shapes in slanting mirror lines (lines of symmetry that do not stand up or lie across: the code upright-line-only, steps 02 and 03; the lesson keeps completions to lines up or across, docs/79 D8). The study was of pupils aged 11–16. Read 2026-11-16. The lesson's misconceptions and feedback are its own design; this source only shows the idea has been seen in children's work. No figures, wording or frequencies are taken from it.
note.zh: 在反射题里，最难的一级是把旗形等图形在斜的镜线里作反射（不竖也不横的对称轴：误解码 upright-line-only，第 02、03 步；本课补全题只用竖轴、横轴，docs/79 D8）。研究对象是 11–16 岁的学生。2026-11-16 读过。本课的误解目录和反馈是自己设计的；这份来源只说明孩子确实会这样想，不取它的数字、措辞或出现频率。

text.en: MOE approved textbook list (for the usual order of topics only, not copied).
text.zh: 教育部批准教材目录（只参考通常的教学顺序，不照抄）。

note.en: Figures, questions and wording in this lesson are our own; no letters of the alphabet are used (docs/79 Q5).
note.zh: 本课的图形、题目和措辞都是自己写的；不用字母（docs/79 Q5）。
